checkpoint_design: A distinct owner-controlled signer attests (log sequence, graph root, terminal closure hash); independently stored immutable checkpoint survives writer-store rollback. Reject missing, stale or invalid signature before claim or dataset compilation.
closure: Certificate binds terminal EVENT_ID, graph frontier/root, expected evidence manifest and completeness. Missing or corrupt closure -> INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE.
commit_protocol: Validate and commit action/observation EVENT with backward parents and empty produced lists.
Commit raw/derived EVIDENCE, ARTIFACT, FINDING or DECISION citing prior causing event.
Commit separate PUBLICATION/RESOLUTION EVENT referencing already committed produced objects.
Commit terminal graph closure after expected manifest/frontier and checkpoint verification.
derived_views: Forward traversals and search indexes rebuild from authoritative log; no view mutates committed graph.
durability: Authenticated append with payload SHA-256, previous/parent commitments, monotone sequence and externally trusted graph root checkpoint; detect deletion, reorder, truncation and rollback.
ordering: Committed sequence and parent commitment define causality. UTC timestamps are observations only.
truth_boundary: Intent is not effect; observed result requires supporting raw evidence. DAG/hash alone proves neither truth nor completeness.
validation: Resolve every typed reference uniquely to earlier immutable committed record; require allowed type/scope, exact parent hierarchy and authenticated writer. Reject self-edge, cycle, wrong/dangling reference, forged parent, retroactive mutation or unauthorized cross-session/RUN link. Cross-RUN repair requires explicit DECISION edge and keeps failed RUN.
